oil.when: 2014–2015 with the MENU and SET/CLR buttons
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, press the MENU button until Remaining Oil Life shows on the display.
While the oil life screen is showing, press the SET/CLR button.
After a few seconds a single chime sounds and the oil life reads 100%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2014 and 2015 owner's manuals.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire label on the driver's door pillar.
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressures are corrected, then goes off.
If the light comes on at a cold start and goes off as you drive, a tire is getting low, so check all four with a gauge.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2014 owner's manual. If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that adding air will not fix.

notes: Even if the oil life system has not asked for a change, change the oil and filter at least once a year.
